description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcTrafficData operation to query real-time back-to-origin traffic data for accelerated domain names
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcTrafficData查询域名实时回源流量监控数据
name: DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcTrafficData

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. To specify multiple domain names, separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 加速域名，多个域名用逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据起始时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

DataInterval.description_en:
The time interval between data points, in seconds.

The value is fixed at 60 (1 minute), 300 (5 minutes), or 3600 (1 hour), and varies with the time span of the query. For more information, see the data time granularity table in the Usage notes section
DataInterval.description_zh:
每条记录的时间间隔，以秒为单位。

根据单次查询的最大时间跨度不同，该参数固定返回60（1分钟）、300（5分钟）或3600（1小时），具体请参见使用说明中返回数据时间粒度

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range

StartTime.description_en: The beginning of the time range
